method.name: ConfigureFaultInterrupt
method.brief: Configure the delivery of fault interrupts.
method.description: With AIA enabled, MSI delivery is preferred when supported. Without AIA, the IOMMU must support WSI. To receive a wired interrupt parsing the device tree is necessary to create the correct IRQHandler object. This system call allows user level to enable fault interrupts and to program the MSI information the IOMMU requires to deliver the interrupt.

param.name: enable
param.description: Zero will disable fault interrupts, non zero enables them.

param.name: identity
param.description: Local supervisor IMSIC interrupt identity, ignored for WSI.

error.name: seL4_InvalidArgument
error.description: The MSI identity is zero or exceeds the local IMSIC's supported range.

error.name: seL4_IllegalOperation
error.description: The invoked capability is not an IOMMU control capability, or hardware cannot represent the MSI destination

method.name: MapFaultQueue
method.brief: Register a frame as the IOMMU fault queue.
method.description: The frame must be unmapped and have read and write permission. The frame will be used as the fault queue for the IOMMU it is being bound to. Use RWFaultQueue to update the head register and read the tail and status registers.

error.name: seL4_InvalidCapability
error.description: The supplied capability is not a frame with required permissions.

error.name: seL4_DeleteFirst
error.description: The supplied frame capability is mapped or the IOMMU fault queue is already bound.

error.name: seL4_IllegalOperation
error.description: The invoked capability is not an IOMMU control capability, or the hardware cannot represent the queue base or size.

method.name: RWFaultQueue
method.brief: Update the fault-queue head, and read its tail and status.

param.name: head
param.description: The next record to be consumed, modulo the queue's entry count.

param.name: clearErrors
param.description: Bitmask of seL4_IOMMUFaultMemoryError and seL4_IOMMUFaultOverflow to clear.

param.name: tail
param.description: The hardware index of the next record to be written.

param.name: status
param.description: A copy of the fqcsr.

error.name: seL4_IllegalOperation
error.description: The IOMMU has no active fault queue.

method.name: InvalidateFirstStage
method.brief: Invalidate first stage caches relevant to the device.
method.description: Used to issue first stage invalidation commands. These include seL4_IOMMUInvalidatePDT to invalidate the device context and all associated PDT entries with IODIR.INVAL_DDT. Use seL4_IOMMUInvalidatePSCID to invalidate cached translations for the supplied PSCID within the device's GSCID with IOTINVAL.VMA. Use seL4_IOMMUInvalidateAllPSCID to invalidate all cached translations for the device's GSCID including global mappings. NOTE: seL4_IOMMUInvalidateAllPSCID affects the first-stage translation cache entries of all devices on the same IOMMU that use the VSpace this device object is bound to. Currently it is the mechanism to clear global entries but maybe we can move the invocation or increase required authority.

param.name: kind
param.description: Select the type of invalidation: PDT, PSCID, AllPSCID

param.name: pscid
param.description: Low 20 bits are used for the PSCID otherwise ignored.

error.name: seL4_IllegalOperation
error.description: The capability does not support this invocation or PDT invalidation was requested but DDT is disabled.

error.name: seL4_InvalidArgument
error.description: The invalidation kind is not supported.
